crossRefs.note: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:
yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;
if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures:
One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life…
For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to…
They are planted in Yahweh’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.
“Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine, and does them, I will liken him to a wise man, who built his house…
They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.
She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet, and heard his word.
But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”
Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.
You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”
They continued steadfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.
Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind…
Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.
But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

translations.web: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.
translations.bsb: Blessed is the man who listens to me, watching daily at my doors, waiting at the posts of my doorway.
translations.kjv: Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.
translations.asv: Blessed is the man that heareth me, Watching daily at my gates, Waiting at the posts of my doors.
